_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/stationsplein.json — RoomSpec for Stationsplein (the city, district 7: Centraal): the square before Centraal Station: the Prins Hendrikkade across its south side where Damrak runs in, the trams' terminus, buses left where they stood, bikes by the hundred, the army's checkpoint funnelling the crowd to the station's middle arch, and over it all the station's long front, floodlit. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).

interactables.text: Centraal. The army chained the side doors and left the middle arch open. The lights are still on inside.

interactables.title: Notice, taped to the table
interactables.text:
MUNICIPALITY OF AMSTERDAM - EVACUATION

No trains will run from Centraal. Metro 52 runs north to Noord until 00:30, then the line is closed.

Take only what you can carry. Do not go back for anyone. Do not go near the water.
